privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.description: How DropVox handles your data and privacy.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: DropVox is a macOS app that transcribes audio files using on-device AI. Your privacy is fundamental to how we built this product. Audio processing happens entirely on your Mac — no audio data is ever sent to our servers or any third party.

audioProcessing.title: Audio Processing
audioProcessing.text: All transcription is performed locally on your Mac using WhisperKit, an optimized implementation of OpenAI's Whisper model for Apple Silicon.

items.noUpload: Your audio files are never uploaded to any server
items.noStorage: No audio data is stored beyond your local machine
items.noAccess: We have no ability to access your audio files or transcriptions

purchase.title: At Purchase
purchase.text: When you purchase a DropVox Pro license, we collect your email address (provided to Stripe during checkout). This is used solely to deliver your license key and for purchase-related communication.

license.title: License Activation
license.text: When you activate a license, your machine ID (a hardware identifier) is sent to our server to manage device activations. Each license supports up to 3 machines. We also receive your app version and OS version for compatibility checks.

telemetry.title: Anonymous Telemetry (Opt-Out)
telemetry.text: DropVox includes optional, anonymous telemetry via TelemetryDeck to help us improve the app.

items.events: Events tracked: app launches, transcription start/complete/fail, model downloads
items.noPersonal: No personal information, audio content, or transcription text is ever included
items.optOut: You can disable telemetry in Settings > General > "Help Improve DropVox"

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.stripe: Payment processing. Handles credit card information securely. We never see or store your card details.
thirdParties.resend: Transactional email delivery. Used to send license keys and restore emails.
thirdParties.supabase: Database hosting. Stores license records (key, email, machine activations).
thirdParties.telemetrydeck: Privacy-focused analytics. Collects anonymous usage signals with no personal identifiers.

noTracking.title: No Tracking
noTracking.text: DropVox does not use tracking cookies, advertising networks, or any form of cross-site tracking. The website uses privacy-focused analytics that do not track individual users.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.text: License records are retained as long as your license is active. If you request deletion, we will remove your data within 30 days. Telemetry data is automatically aggregated and anonymized.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to request data deletion, contact us at

supportPage.title: Support
supportPage.subtitle: Need help? We're here for you.

github.title: Report a Bug
github.description: Email us about any issues you encounter

modelDownload.q: The model download is stuck or failing
modelDownload.a: Ensure you have a stable internet connection. Models range from 75MB to 3GB. Try a smaller model first (Tiny or Base). If the download fails, restart DropVox and try again — it will resume where it left off.

accuracy.a: Try a larger model for better accuracy. The Small or Medium models work well for most audio. Also ensure the correct language is selected — or use Auto-Detect. Clear audio with minimal background noise gives the best results.

formats.a: DropVox supports .opus (WhatsApp default), .mp3, .m4a, and .wav files. If your file isn't recognized, try converting it to one of these formats.

offline.a: Yes! After downloading a Whisper model, all transcription happens locally on your Mac with no internet required. Internet is only needed for the initial model download and license activation.

free.q: What's included in the free tier?
free.a: The free tier includes 3 transcriptions per day with a maximum duration of 60 seconds per file. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited transcriptions with no duration limits.

activate.q: How do I activate my license?
activate.a: Open DropVox, go to Settings > License, paste your license key, and click Activate. Your key was sent to the email you used at checkout.

machines.q: How many machines can I use?
machines.a: Each DropVox Pro license can be activated on up to 3 machines. If you need to move your license to a new machine, contact support.

lost.a: Visit the Restore License page and enter the email you used during purchase. We'll send your license key(s) to that email.

requirements.a: DropVox requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later and an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer). Intel Macs are not supported.

storage.q: How much storage do the models use?
storage.a: Models range from ~75MB (Tiny) to ~3GB (Large). You only download the model you choose. Models are stored in ~/Library/Caches/ and can be deleted anytime.

privacy.q: Is my audio sent to the cloud?
privacy.a: No. All transcription happens locally on your Mac using WhisperKit. Your audio files never leave your device. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

restore.title: Lost your license key?
restore.text: Enter the email you used at checkout and we'll send your license key(s).

restorePage.hint: If a license is found, we'll send the key to your email. For security, we won't confirm whether an account exists.

success.title: Check your email
success.text: If we found a license associated with that email, we've sent the key(s) to your inbox. Check your spam folder if you don't see it within a few minutes.

q1.question: What are the system requirements?
q1.answer: DropVox requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later and an Apple Silicon Mac (M1, M2, M3, or later). WhisperKit is optimized specifically for Apple's Neural Engine, so Intel Macs are not supported.

q2.question: Why doesn't it work on Intel Macs?
q2.answer: DropVox uses WhisperKit, Apple's optimized implementation of Whisper AI. WhisperKit leverages the Neural Engine in Apple Silicon chips for fast, efficient transcription. Intel Macs don't have this hardware.

q3.question: How does the license work?
q3.answer: Your license is a one-time purchase valid for DropVox v1.x. You can use it on up to 3 machines. When v2 releases with major new features, you'll have the option to upgrade.

q4.question: What's the difference between the Whisper models?
q4.answer: DropVox offers 5 models: Tiny (75MB, fastest), Base (145MB, fast), Small (470MB, balanced), Medium (1.5GB, accurate), and Large (3GB, most accurate). Larger models are slower but more accurate. Free tier uses Base; Pro unlocks all models.

q5.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q5.answer: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

q6.question: Can I get a refund?
q6.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.

q7.question: What happens to my transcriptions?
q7.answer: All transcriptions happen locally on your Mac using WhisperKit AI. Your audio never leaves your computer - we have no access to your data. History is stored locally and can be cleared anytime.

q8.question: Do I need an internet connection?
q8.answer: Internet is only needed to download the AI model initially and to validate your license occasionally. Transcription itself works completely offline.
